description: Make a clean .glb without Blender: a ready-made `kind` (car, tree, house, boat, aircraft, terrain, ... see three_model_spec) or one of the 1000 library assets by id (furniture/dining-chair-oak-ladder, see three_model_library) with `params`, or your own `spec`. Deterministic (the same request gives the same bytes), a node per part with UVs and normals, unique node names as GLTFLoader shows them. Writes `out` in the project (undoable with three_undo) and returns the size, triangles and the lint. Look at it with three_model_view afterwards.

out.description: where to write the .glb, e.g. public/models/car.glb

path.description: Project folder, or a file or folder in it (relative to the server's folder; default: the project).

textures.description: false: plain colours instead of texture maps (smaller)

name: three_model_build
title: Build a .glb from a kind or a spec
